title: Rift world map
hook: The **rift world map** is where you go — sectors joined by lanes, legions you march, ground you claim, and fog you push through.

blindSpots.meaning: The adventure stage: a network of sectors and lanes. Not the lawn, and not the finished empire stage HUD.
A node of ground you can claim, hold, or lose. Your capital sector is the homeworld.
A force you march along lanes. Movement and fights hang on legions, not on a free camera fly-to.
The world clock. Orders wait until you press it — see [virtual turns](virtual-turns).

alsoTrue: You are Dave. Find Zomboss’s fortress and take it before your homeworld falls.
Buildings, richer map tools, and map→battle handoff are still WIP. Three-layer presentation and the generator stay Vision.

sections.title: What it is
paras: A graph of sectors joined by lanes. You scout through fog, march legions, claim ground, and read Zomboss as a real opponent.
Holding a sector grants full sight of it — standing on your own land is never a guessing game.
sections.note: Win and lose live on [The game](^the-game.md): take Zomboss’s fortress, or lose the homeworld.

sections.title: How it works

cards.name: March and claim
cards.body: Move legions along lanes; claim sectors; watch supply and contact.

cards.name: Hold
cards.body: Ground is not free to keep — [loam](loam) and neglect make holdings real.

cards.name: Opponent
cards.body: [Zomboss](zomboss-commander) runs his own war from his own fog.

diagram: Sanctum  ->  World map  ->  march / claim / End Turn

groups.title: Travel to World
groups.intro: Open the World stage from the Sanctum when travel is available.
steps: Select a legion and move along lanes.
Claim when contact allows, then press End Turn when orders are set.
groups.note: Later doors into delves, cede, dowse, lenses, and the outliner are WIP / Vision — see [map orders](map-orders).

doSteps: Travel to World from the Sanctum.
Move one legion one step and notice fog vs clear ground.
Press End Turn once so you see everyone’s orders resolve.
doNote: Stop when map ≠ lawn and End Turn ≠ a diary clock. Next: [virtual turns](virtual-turns) and [fog of war](fog-of-war).

mixUps.a: No. Time is virtual turns — you press End Turn.

mixUps.q: Is the full empire HUD here?
mixUps.a: Thin map surface is playable. Finished world-stage place is Vision — see [world stage](world-stage).

mixUps.q: Does Zomboss see my whole save?
mixUps.a: No. He evaluates from his fog — see [Zomboss](zomboss-commander).

mixUps.q: Can I enter a delve from a sector today?
mixUps.a: Delve doors are Vision. Map play today is march, claim, End Turn, fog, Zomboss.
